highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings Skia m151, significant hot-path performance gains, and WASM .NET 11 support.
highlights_body: Multiple P/Invoke round-trips are replaced with managed arithmetic across colour conversion, premultiplication, and shaper paths. WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11 and the new exnref exception-handling model. A CPU raster regression from m151 is also fixed.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, with three rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs included.
SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was restored to prevent a CPU image-sampling performance regression introduced in the initial m151 integration.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing and ReadOnlySpan overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor hex parsing is optimized and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads are added, reducing allocations in colour-parsing hot paths.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native resource was leaked when FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) failed to decode; it is now correctly released.

bullets.lead: Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions
bullets.detail: The unsafe modifier on GRContextOptions was unnecessary and has been removed, keeping the public API surface clean.

bullets.lead: SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply are now pure managed integer arithmetic, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these hot paths.
Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free using a pooled encoder, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse no longer allocates a per-call char[4]. These are high-frequency paths in text-shaping workloads.

bullets.lead: SKShaper glyph results read via zero-copy spans
bullets.detail: SKShaper now reads glyph output via zero-copy spans instead of copying arrays, reducing GC pressure in text layout.
The per-call char[4] allocation in SKFourByteTag.Parse is eliminated, benefiting callers that parse font tables in a loop.
Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 are added, built with the new exnref exception-handling model. A preview-.NET WASM test job validates exception-handling compatibility on each PR.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11, and fixed the Skia WASM submodule to drop an SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 landed the managed colour-conversion ports, the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries, additional chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs, and the CPU raster regression fix.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced SKColor hex-parsing improvements, HarfBuzzSharp allocation fixes, the SKShaper zero-copy spans, and multiple chrome/m151 upstream syncs.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151.0 line on Skia m151, bringing the initial engine upgrade and the GRContextOptions cleanup.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse paths, reducing GC pressure in text-shaping workloads.
